sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by a general sluggishness and lack of vital force. It is useful in cases of constipation and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general feeling of dryness and lack of secretions. The patient is often a thin, dry person. There is a marked tendency to paralysis and loss of control over the muscles.
sections.Mind: Confused and forgetful. Depression and anxiety. Fears that the mind will give way. Time passes too slowly.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo. Scalp feels tight.
sections.Eyes: Burning and itching of the eyelids. Dimness of vision. Double vision.
sections.Nose: Chronic catarrh of the nose. Dryness and obstruction. Sneezing.
sections.Face: Expression of pain and anxiety. Pale and sallow. Sensation of a cobweb on the face.
sections.Mouth: Dryness of the mouth. Tongue feels dry and sticky.
sections.Throat: Dryness and rawness in the throat. Sensation of a splinter in the throat. Constant desire to swallow. Hawking of mucus.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Thirst. Heaviness and pressure after eating. Craving for dry food.
sections.Abdomen: Distended with gas. Rumbling. Flatulence. Chronic constipation.
sections.Rectum: Stool large, hard, and dry. Much straining, even with soft stool. Constipation. Anus feels dry and sore.
sections.Urinary: Frequent desire to urinate. Scanty urine.
sections.Female: Leucorrhoea, with a sensation of dryness. Menses scanty and delayed.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, ending in sneezing.
sections.Back: Stiffness and aching in the back. Sensitiveness of the spine to touch.
sections.Extremities: Aching and lameness in the limbs. Heaviness in the legs. Trembling of the hands.
sections.Skin: Dry and scaly. Itching and burning. Eruptions like miliary rash.
sections.Modalities: Worse in the morning and from dry food. Better from open air and moderate motion.
sections.Relationship: Compare: Alumen; Baryta carbonica; Conium; Silicea.
